title: Strict Weil complex at finite coefficients
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
and the coefficient
conventions of this trace-formula blueprint: $A=A_{E,n}$, $X_0$
separated finite type over $k_0$, $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, on the
small pro-etale site. A
*strict Weil complex at $A$* is a pair $(K,\varphi)$ with
$K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and an isomorphism formed using the
derived pullback

$$
\varphi:Lg_\gamma^*K\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K,
$$

where $g_\gamma=g_X$ is the
geometric-Frobenius
automorphism of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]; morphisms are morphisms
of $K$ commuting with $\varphi$. Write
$D^b_{ctf,\mathrm W}(X,A)$ for the resulting category, the finite
coefficient stage of the
Weil-complex category of
the trace-formula chapter, with its forgetful functor $\operatorname{For}$.
This is a category of pairs over $D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$; no triangulated
structure or identification with a derived category of Weil sheaves is
part of this definition. The rational-coefficient category
$D^b_{c,\mathrm W}$ of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] is likewise a category
of pairs, rather than a derived category of Weil sheaves.

The distinction from derived Ext groups is already visible for
$X_0=\operatorname{Spec}k_0$: a nonsplit Frobenius extension of $A$ by $A$
(a Jordan block) gives no nonzero map $(A,\mathrm{can})\to(A[1],\mathrm{can})$
of pairs on $X=\operatorname{Spec}k$.

blueprint_update.statement:

and the coefficient
conventions of this trace-formula blueprint: $A=A_{E,n}$, $X_0$
separated finite type over $k_0$, $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, on the
small pro-etale site. A
*strict Weil complex at $A$* is a pair $(K,\varphi)$ with
$K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ and an isomorphism formed using the

$$
\varphi:Lg_\gamma^*K\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K,

Weil-complex category of
the trace-formula chapter, with its forgetful functor $\operatorname{For}$.
